## Description and Rationale

A one-person independent team from Norway: an engineer working with AI-agent tooling on applied time-series and tabular machine learning. We regularly compete in data-science challenges (structural-break detection on CrunchDAO, estimation challenges on AIcrowd) and registered to test our streaming-feature + gradient-boosting stack on real operational aviation data.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: Norway
* Number of team members: 1
